name: ha-mcp
description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants.
one_liner: Lets you talk to your smart home (lights, thermostats, locks) through Claude or ChatGPT instead of digging through an app, and lets the AI set up automations for you.
buyer: A smart-home installer or home-automation consultant who sets up Home Assistant for clients and wants to offer 'just talk to it' AI control as a premium feature.
business_use_cases: A home-automation installer bundles this setup into every job so clients can ask their AI assistant to create routines ('turn off everything at night') instead of learning the Home Assistant UI.
An elder-care or accessibility service configures it so a family member can set up or adjust a relative's smart home remotely via simple AI chat, no app required.
A short-term rental host uses it to let an AI assistant manage climate/lighting automations across multiple properties from one chat interface.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup/configuration of HA-MCP as an add-on to smart home installation jobs
Managed smart-home-via-AI subscription for rental hosts managing multiple properties

steal_this: Offer existing Home Assistant users in a local Facebook/Nextdoor group a $50 'AI-ify your smart home' setup session this weekend using this integration.
